name: Bryan E. Colvard
prior_offices: Weston County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Bryan E. Colvard is the Weston County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Official February 4, 2025, commissioners minutes record him appearing before the board as sheriff. The News Letter Journal reported that he held off a Republican primary challenge, receiving 1,274 votes, about 60%.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
